impact:
ESCALATED to critical 2026-08-30: this is no longer latent. With ISS-045's timeout fixed, it is now the sole thing keeping PERSONA frozen.

LIVE CONFIRMATION (end-to-end run against the real API, 118-line PERSONA, 54.9s): the request completed, the model emitted output, then exhausted max_tokens before writing the closing </PERSONA> tag. The parse regex missed and synthesize() returned null at src/synthesize.ts with "Synthesis skipped — model did not produce output." The truncated output began correctly ("# Cognitive Fingerprint / *This file grows over time...*") and simply ran out of budget mid-document.

MEASURED: required output (PERSONA 12,828B + PLAYBOOK 2,244B + ACTIVE 955B = 16,027B) is ~4,006 tokens. An isolated verbatim re-emit measured 3,790 tokens. max_tokens is 4096. Under real synthesis — where the model must also ADD this session's observations — the total exceeds the ceiling, which is what the live run demonstrated.

INCONSISTENT GUARDRAIL: PERSONA_LINE_LIMIT = 600 gates the trim instruction ("the persona is N lines (limit: 600), summarize the oldest dated sections"). The output ceiling binds at ~118 lines. The two limits disagree by roughly 5x, so the mechanism designed to keep PERSONA synthesizable can never fire before the failure it exists to prevent.

SILENT FAILURE MODE: truncation and a genuinely malformed response are indistinguishable — both hit the same `return null`. stop_reason ("max_tokens" vs "end_turn") is available on the response and is currently ignored.

FIX DIRECTION: raise max_tokens; reconcile PERSONA_LINE_LIMIT with the actual token ceiling (derive one from the other rather than hardcoding both, so the trim instruction fires BEFORE the ceiling binds); branch on stop_reason === "max_tokens" to log truncation distinctly from a malformed response. Longer term, emit a diff/patch instead of a full-document re-emit so output size stops scaling with corpus size.
resolution:
FIXED in src/synthesize.ts. Together with ISS-045 this restores synthesis end-to-end.

The underlying defect was not the number 4096 — it was that the output ceiling and the trim guardrail were two independently chosen magic numbers that between them described a request the model could not satisfy. Both are now derived from the ISS-045 measurement.

Changes:
1. `OBSERVED_OUTPUT_TOKENS_PER_SEC = 72` — the measured Haiku throughput (3,790 tokens in 52.9s), named so the timeout and output budgets stay derivable from evidence.
2. `MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 16_384` replaces the inline `max_tokens: 4096`. ~4x the measured corpus rather than 90 tokens of headroom.
3. `PERSONA_LINE_LIMIT = 600` DELETED. The trim instruction now fires on `estimateReEmitTokens(persona, playbook) > MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS * 0.6` — i.e. while the documents can still be re-emitted, since an instruction to shorten them is useless once emitting them at all no longer fits. The instruction now reports actual token figures instead of a line count against an unrelated limit.
4. `stop_reason === "max_tokens"` is now checked before the parse. Truncation and a genuinely malformed response previously landed on the same silent `return null`, which is why this stayed invisible until it was reproduced by hand. They now log distinctly.

INVARIANT TEST (the part that prevents recurrence): a test asserts worst-case generation at MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS (16,384 / 72 tok/s = 227.6s) fits inside SYNTHESIS_TIMEOUT_MS (300s). The two constants can no longer drift into an unsatisfiable pair without a test failing.

VERIFICATION — end-to-end against the real API and the live corpus, not mocks:
  timeout budget : 300000ms (was 30000)
  persona in     : 118 lines
  elapsed        : 69.0s
  persona out    : 126 lines
  playbook out   : 44 lines
  active out     : 5 patterns
  => SUCCESS

That is the first successful synthesis since ~2026-05-26. The verification path is read-only (synthesize() returns a result and writes nothing), so no file in ~/.zug was modified.

Tests: 5 new cases in an "output budget (ISS-046)" block — budget headroom vs the measured corpus, the generatable-within-timeout invariant, trim fires before the ceiling, the trim message carries real token figures, and truncation vs malformed are reported distinctly. The two obsolete 600-line trim tests were removed; they asserted the broken trigger. Suite 211/211 green, tsc --noEmit clean.

NOT DEPLOYED. PERSONA on zug-mcp stays frozen until a Fly deploy; deploy was deliberately excluded from the autonomous session.
title: Synthesis max_tokens ceiling leaves 7.5% headroom; PERSONA_LINE_LIMIT=600 guardrail never engages
